items.title: Bootc: bootc: failed bootc-root-setup can switch root into the unverified sysroot
items.summary: A flaw was found in bootc. On a sealed composefs boot, a failed bootc-root-setup.service does not fail initrd-root-fs.target, so the initramfs can switch root into the unverified physical root under the original signed UKI.

items.title: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 Memory Leak via Non-Atomic RDPDR IRP Stream Refcount
items.summary: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a race condition in asynchronous RDPDR IRP processing that allows malicious RDP servers to leak client memory through non-atomic wStream reference count updates. Attackers can send repeated IRPs, such as smartcard redirection requests, so concurrent Stream Release() calls lose decrements and accumulate unreleased streams, exhausting memory and causing denial of service.

items.summary: It was noticed an XSS in certain 404 pages that could be exploited to perform an XSS attack. Chrome will detect this as a reflected XSS attempt and prevent the page from loading.
